sources.title: NVIDIA DGX B200
supports: NVIDIA presents DGX B200 as an NVIDIA data-center AI system; the page describes an eight-GPU DGX B200 configuration.

sources.title: Intel Gaudi Documentation, version 1.24.2
supports: The current documentation covers Intel Gaudi 2 and Gaudi 3 accelerators.
The documentation includes inference workflows for PyTorch, vLLM, and SGLang.
does_not_establish: Relative performance, total cost, or list prices versus NVIDIA.
A complete system offer or regional availability.
sources.date_note: Documentation displayed version 1.24.2 when reviewed on 2026-10-22; its release date was not verified.

sources.title: Intel and IBM Announce the Availability of Intel Gaudi 3 AI Accelerators on IBM Cloud
supports: IBM announced Intel Gaudi 3 availability on IBM Cloud in Frankfurt (eu-de) and Washington, D.C. (us-east).
The announcement said Dallas (us-south) availability was planned for Q2 2025.
The announcement describes virtual-server and planned managed-container deployment options.
does_not_establish: Availability from Intel directly or availability through all cloud providers.
Availability in all United States or European regions.
Comparable price or performance against NVIDIA systems.
sources.date_note: IBM says the announcement was made at Intel Vision 2025; exact publication date was not independently confirmed.
